t: You're at Billingsgate Market, a fish market building in the City of London dating from 1852. It was designed by James Bunstone Bunning, an English architect who held the post of architect to the City of London from 1843 until his death in 1863. Bunning is probably best remembered for his design for the Coal Exchange. So this building comes from the man who, for twenty years, was responsible for the City's own architecture.
